old_summaryOfChange:
Clarification of known TCI state definition 
It is agreed in RAN4#91 (R4-1907305 ad hoc minutes);
Agreement:
The known TCI state is defined by the time from the latest measurement resource for the TCI to when TCI activation command is received, 
If the period is less than X, the TCI state is considered as known. Otherwise the TCI state is considered as unknown.
Before when TCI activation command is received
L1 RSRP measurement for the RS to which the target TCI is QCLed with should be reported
The QCLed condition shall be specified in the specification.

Update to definition of first SSB to clarify that first SSB should be used to derive timing for target TCI state
Update to define values for different QCL types
Update to condition for RRC based TCI switch delay requirements
Corrections to sub-section titles
